model_proposal.rationale: Contract internal gates toward neighbor-median coordinates (e.g., node 4→[24,21] from [24,23]; node 5→[22,24] from [22,23]; node 10→[22,24] co-locates with 5 to share fanin routing; node 7→[24,23] aligns with 4/5 vertical stack; node 8→[24,26] shortens 4→8 and 7→8 paths; node 11→[23,29] reduces vertical span from y=31 to y=29, tightening top-bound while preserving output arrival. All moves stay within sparse vacancy hotspots (e.g., [18–21,23–26], [25–27,29–31]) and avoid collisions. This coordinated shift reduces max_y from 34 to 29 (height 15→10) and min_x unchanged, targeting area ≤100 tiles; edge manhattan sums drop by ≥10, enabling reroute with fewer steps and lower QCA cells.
